name: FFS_PLUGIN_HOSTED
description: Contains a list of hosted plugins configured in the system.

columns.name: PLUGIN_HOSTED_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of Hosted Plugin (Plugin Archive), automatically populated by the system.

columns.name: SALT
columns.description: Salt will be added to the path to prevent guessing of other plugins by ID.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Hosted Plugin Label. The same as FFS_ACTION_LINK.ACTION_LINK_ID value.

columns.name: CURRENT_PLUGIN_HOSTED_VER_ID
columns.description: Current version of Hosted Plugin (Plugin Archive) that is used.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
